cohort: The study included 1237 primiparous women who delivered at the Obstetrics Department of Hunan Maternal and Child Health Hospital.
finding: Compared with forceps-assisted vaginal delivery (FAVD), vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery (VAVD) was associated with longer labor, a higher incidence of uterine atony, and increased risks of moderate and severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) and neonatal scalp hematoma.
mod_finding: Vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery (VAVD) was associated with longer labor duration, a higher likelihood of postpartum hemorrhage, and increased neonatal scalp hematoma incidence compared with forceps-assisted vaginal delivery (FAVD).
